mode: read-only function-level source comparison; no complete function certified by name or existence

entries.evidence: NASA lines97-147 construct entry vector relative to Sun, parent-orientation up, content customDistance, 1.3 fit, two-stage transition and cinematic option. Ours defaults OrbitView yaw/pitch or approved System selection; planetary Nearby does not derive Sun-facing entry direction. No goToPlanet symbol exists in this recovered file.
entries.impact: Planet initial illumination/framing and roll cannot be called identical; implement reference/up contract before polishing transitions.

entries.evidence: NASA lines173-224 use parent-relative spacecraft position, parent up/ecliptic normal, customDistance, vertical/horizontal offsets. Ours uses reviewed one-shot target/sky external composition plus fixed presets.
entries.impact: User-approved task-background difference; keep it explicit rather than treating it as a recovered NASA instrument boresight.

entries.evidence: NASA lines226-270 exposes explicit signed forward/up axes, instrument parent, instrument radius and transition. Current initialLook supplies only external composition relative to an entity.
entries.impact: Instrument optical-axis first-person mode must be a separate controlled feature; current external composition is not equivalent.

entries.evidence: NASA accepts latitude/longitude surface location and camera options; current SDK has nearby/system/follow with no geodetic surface target.
entries.impact: Surface navigation/location stories cannot be mapped to ordinary body focus.

entries.evidence: NASA has explicit recovered exponential transition function and parent transition coordinates. Ours uses current display/settings-aware blending; exact curve/parent transition equality has not been established.
entries.impact: Source-level transition name parity is not a timing or continuity verification.

entries.evidence: NASA has a separate in/out exponential easing path; current camera has no public choice matching both functions.
entries.impact: Multi-stage cinematic/story transitions require a shared transition contract.

entries.evidence: NASA comparison takes left/right entities and cameras with separate framing/context; no current comparison runtime or dual comparison viewport API found.
entries.impact: Do not claim complete Eyes UI parity; depends on viewport/input ownership before implementation.

entries.evidence: NASA location supports plane/reference entities and planeMode; no corresponding scene-link or camera observation DTO fields.
entries.impact: Location/event flows need explicit reference-frame and target contracts.

entries.evidence: Current Follow provides reference-relative external placement, but recovered alignObjects is a separate script with its own focus/offset/transition options.
entries.impact: Do not substitute Follow for every alignment tool.

entries.evidence: NASA lines440 onward traverses to physical parent, computes surface-relative direction and radius-scaled alignment. Ours initialLook target computes opposite camera side once and retains foreground craft.
entries.impact: Approved composition covers task background, not all surface-alignment semantics.

entries.evidence: NASA side view derives orbital/reference geometry and optional signed up axis. Ours side preset assigns fixed yaw pi/2,pitch0 in display basis.
entries.impact: A fixed world-axis side preset is not guaranteed orbital side view across inclined systems.

entries.evidence: NASA lines532-538 sets LOOK_AT context; current initialLook is a one-shot external nearby composition and Follow continuously uses reference direction.
entries.impact: Preserve distinction between entry composition, continuing lock and sensor first-person; context state is not interchangeable.

entries.evidence: NASA exposes distinct LOCKED_ON context; ours has no separate locked-on mode or lifecycle.
entries.impact: Cannot label Follow/initialLook as complete locked-on implementation.

entries.evidence: NASA lines546 onward has includeChildren, named extra entities, angle, physical barycenter resolution and default exclusion of sc-prefixed craft. Ours passes ready primary moon members with budgets and fixed preset/system minimums.
entries.impact: Child membership and entry angle differ; artificial orbiters excluded from natural system fit is not by itself a regression.

entries.evidence: Both have explicit system observation rather than changing scientific positions; ours applies NASA minimum distance table and separate framing tests. Recovered goToSystem chooses script options and physical system context. NASA also has explicit inner_solar_system(7e8km) and outer_solar_system(1e10km) named entry contexts; current known-ID router lacks these dedicated camera contexts.
entries.impact: Tests of fit/minimums do not prove whole source function equivalence.

entries.evidence: Ours uses aspect-aware horizontal/vertical fit and freezes entry framing to avoid continuous zoom pumping. NASA also derives fit from members and options, with additional reference and timing semantics. NASA preserves previous-camera relative approach by default and computes orbit/plane-relative up and 25-degree system angle, plus a portrait-specific distance adjustment; current entry resets OrbitView and does not reproduce that whole sequence.
entries.impact: Retain existing geometry tests; add same-epoch paired camera trajectories for full verification.

entries.evidence: No multi-entity sampled center camera intent or link representation matching this recovered script.
entries.impact: Needed for comparison/location tools; cannot use an arbitrary existing body as a fake center.

entries.evidence: No location center + plane/reference + sampleTime API.
entries.impact: Depends on location and multi-entity center implementation.

entries.evidence: Current overview/system lacks location-preserving parent-system context.
entries.impact: Navigation cannot restore a location context that is not represented.

entries.evidence: Overview clears selected context; no explicit location projection in solar-system coordinates.
entries.impact: Story/location continuity remains incomplete.

entries.evidence: NASA lines169-250 accepts transition parent, keyframes, duration, custom transition, destination/up, zoom/select/roll/cinematic. Ours validates controlled intent, blends in scientific floating origin and enforces solid-sphere collision, without complete keyframe/roll contract.
entries.impact: API capability boundary is intentionally narrower; full source routing cannot yet be represented.

entries.evidence: NASA lines252-313 uses 5x target extent offset, parent/orbit-derived up, target-angular-radius vertical offset, transition parent and radius clamps. Ours uses global Vec3::Y, FOV-based side offset capped1.5 radii and dynamic reference direction.
entries.impact: Inclined/high-latitude systems and framing/up can differ; fix geometry before changing Follow presentation.

entries.evidence: No equivalent between-position controlled intent.
entries.impact: Some location/compare routes cannot be reconstructed from current nearby/follow modes.

entries.evidence: Recovered zoom multiplies by powers of2 with distinct held/click sensitivity; current UI has separate held/click intention and bounded smoothing.
entries.impact: Timing, drag/hold cancel and multiple-device equivalence require UI evidence, not constants alone.

entries.evidence: NASA context enumerates celestial/spacecraft/instrument/alignment/location/system/look-at/locked-on/compare; current link persists only nearby/system/follow, presets, time/layers/FOV.
entries.impact: Returning from modes not represented cannot match NASA restoration.

entries.evidence: NASA explicit free-fly controller and context restoration exist; no free-fly mode/route in current controlled contract.
entries.impact: Keep keyboard/free camera feature out of claims until implemented and collision/lifecycle reviewed.

entries.evidence: NASA computes target/follow coverage intersection, applies event limits, may navigate to overlap start and rejects disjoint timelines. Ours validates current ready states and falls back Nearby when reference loses coverage.
entries.impact: Follow time UI can permit epochs NASA clamps/jumps; add explicit overlap policy before exposing event Follow.

entries.evidence: NASA temporarily owns forced visibility, search exclusion, label weights/clickability, occlusion, time limits and DOM observers; ours stores mode/followId and performs async revision guards/cleanup but lacks that full owned-state bundle.
entries.impact: Need transactional follow state capture/restore so future label/time fixes do not leak into other modes.

entries.evidence: NASA lines372-397 uses actual horizontal and vertical FOV independently and right/up UI offsets. Ours clamps yaw and pitch against the same long-FOV value and omits panel offsets.
entries.impact: Portrait/sidebar Follow input range differs even though existing native tests keep craft within frame.

entries.evidence: NASA gives follow reference weight201 and suppresses target label clicks, restoring prior values on exit. Ours uses selected-object global hiding and normal layout priorities; no follow-specific weight/click restoration found.
entries.impact: Dense Follow can lose the reference label or route clicks differently; implement after ownership lifecycle.

entries.evidence: NASA temporarily marks followed reference Div non-occludable then restores prior values. Ours applies normal solid-body label occlusion in all modes.
entries.impact: Reference label visibility differs; do not globally disable physical occlusion as a shortcut.

entries.evidence: NASA async follow search excludes current target and followed entity and ranks suggestions; ours presents a general reference combobox with self-reference rejected by runtime.
entries.impact: Search workflow and suggestion semantics remain unmatched.

entries.evidence: Recovered Follow constructs an auxiliary sum-parent context; current implementation computes a direct current-reference direction without equivalent transition-parent object.
entries.impact: Depends on continuous reference frame and transition math; avoid adding an arbitrary scientific body to emulate display-only state.

entries.evidence: NASA only emits selectionupdate/class swap when id changes, distinct from navigation. Ours select always reloads and reissues focus for any known id, including repeated current id.
entries.impact: Repeated selection may reset manual framing; source navigation and selection state should be audited together before deduping.

entries.evidence: NASA unselect clears selection/classes and emits unselect; it is not inherently a camera jump. Ours exposed overview combines selection clear, root data retention/loading and camera overview.
entries.impact: UI deselection and explicit overview are currently coupled; decouple before implementing selection-only actions.

entries.evidence: Ours one canvas gesture calls current WASM hit then select; stale async selections guarded by revision/token; empty hits do nothing. NASA handles nonnull picks by parsed link navigation with keepTime default.
entries.impact: Existing stale-pick/empty-pick tests establish local safety, not all parsed-link routing parity.

entries.evidence: NASA separate DOM label click can suppress the following 3D pick once; our labels and objects share Bevy hit results and a single canvas pointer-up route, so copying its DOM suppression bit is not the same architecture.
entries.impact: Verify exactly one selection for label/model overlap and drag completion; do not install redundant suppression that consumes valid clicks.

entries.evidence: NASA toggles CSS selection class on label DOM; ours hides selected nearby labels per explicit user request and draws all labels in Bevy.
entries.impact: User-approved presentation/architecture difference; cannot be checked by CSS class parity.

entries.evidence: NASA application manager extends common selection and resolves content/link manager aliases; ours uses known target IDs and a strict semantic hash schema.
entries.impact: Content tool aliases and event/instrument route contexts absent; strict parsing alone is not equivalent content routing.

entries.evidence: Ours hover shares current object/label/ring picking and applies trajectory width/opacity; dragging suppresses hover. Source switches highlighted trajectory based on hovered entity.
entries.impact: Current material tests cover endpoints; animated switching and mobile/no-hover lifecycle still need paired verification.

priorityOrder: Reference/up and transition contract for planetary Nearby and Follow geometry
Transactional Follow ownership and target/reference coverage intersection
Aspect/UI-offset limits and reference label policy
limitations: Recovered NASA source only; no new official/live browser paired verification in this audit.
User-approved initial task-background composition and selected-label hiding are explicit differences, not bugs to undo.
Private accessors/constructor storage are excluded from business-entry certification; absence of a named goToPlanet symbol is recorded under goToCelestialObject.
classificationNote: P1/P2 denote confirmed functional parity gaps, not claims of newly introduced regressions or scientific state corruption. No complete function certified verified in this read-only audit.
